# Support

Thank you for using A2UI Core. Here are the best ways to get help.

## Bug Reports

If you've found a bug, please [open an issue](https://github.com/ainative-team/ai-kit-a2ui-core/issues/new) on GitHub. Include steps to reproduce the problem, expected behavior, actual behavior, and your environment details.

## Questions and Discussions

For general questions, ideas, or community conversations, use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/ainative-team/ai-kit-a2ui-core/discussions). This is the best place to ask how-to questions or propose new features.

## Documentation

Project documentation is available in the [docs](../docs) directory and on the [A2UI Core docs site](https://docs.ainative.dev/a2ui-core).

## Security Issues

If you discover a security vulnerability, please do **not** open a public issue. Instead, refer to our [Security Policy](./SECURITY.md) for responsible disclosure instructions.
